item.title: Democratic lawmakers take commemorative photo while impeachment motion against Minister Jeong Dong-young is being discussed… People Power Party asks, "Are you in your right mind?" (정동영 해임건의안 발언 중 기념촬영한 민주당 의원들…국힘 “제정신이냐”)
item.description:
<<>> On the 28th, Democratic Party lawmakers took a photo in front of the podium of the National Assembly plenary chamber, with a People Power Party lawmaker speaking behind them. The purpose was to commemorate the final plenary session attendance of lawmakers who will resign to run in the June 3 local elections. The People Power Party responded, "This goes beyond disrespect toward the opposition party; it is a matter of the dignity and qualifications of ruling party lawmakers responsible for state affairs." ()

On this day, National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik reported the impeachment motion against Unification Minister Jeong Dong-young, submitted by the People Power Party as a party agenda. Subsequently, Rep. Kim Geon, the People Power Party's secretary on the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee, requested a five-minute free speech on the impeachment motion against Minister Jeong. Standing at the podium, Rep. Kim said, "The impeachment motion, proposed out of a sincere desire to protect South Korea's diplomacy and national security, should not be treated lightly." As Rep. Kim began his speech, most Democratic Party lawmakers left the plenary chamber. At this point, some Democratic lawmakers gathered in small groups and took commemorative photos with the front of the plenary chamber as a backdrop, paying no heed to Speaker Woo Won-shik and Rep. Kim proceeding with the session at the front. Lawmakers running in the local elections will step down on the 29th. ( 더불어민주당 의원들이 28일 국회 본회의장 단상에 서서 발언하는 국민의힘 의원을 뒤로 한 채 사진 촬영을 했다. 6·3 지방선거 출마로 사퇴를 앞둔 의원들의 마지막 본회의 참석을 기념하기 위한 목적이었다. 국민의힘은 “야당에 대한 무시 차원을 넘어 국정을 책임지는 여당 의원들의 품격과 자격의 문제”라고 반발했다.)

The People Power Party immediately objected. Rep. Lee Seong-kwon posted on Facebook, "The Democratic Party did not listen to or even look at the (impeachment) proposal," and asked, "Are Democratic lawmakers who take 'commemorative photos' while an opposition party lawmaker is speaking at the National Assembly plenary chamber in their right minds?" He added, "This goes beyond disrespect toward the opposition party; it is a matter of the dignity and qualifications of ruling party lawmakers responsible for state affairs. The Democratic Party's behavior in today's plenary session was not just disqualifying but a reckless act that damaged the national prestige of the Republic of Korea. It must surely face the stern judgment of the people." ( 우원식 국회의장은 이날 국회 본회의에서 국민의힘이 당론으로 제출한 정동영 통일부 장관 해임건의안을 보고했다. 이어 외교통일위원회 국민의힘 간사인 김건 의원이 정 장관 해임건의안과 관련한 5분 자유 발언을 신청했다. 김 의원은 단상에 서서 “대한민국의 외교·안보를 지켜내고자 하는 충정으로 발의한 해임건의안이 가볍게 다뤄져서는 안 된다”고 말했다. 김 의원의 발언이 시작되자 민주당 의원들은 회의장에서 대부분 퇴장했다. 이때 일부 민주당 의원들이 삼삼오오 모여 본회의장 앞쪽을 배경으로 기념 촬영을 했다. 우원식 국회의장과 김 의원이 앞쪽에서 회의를 진행하고 있었는데도 아랑곳하지 않았다. 지방선거에 출마하는 의원들은 오는 29일 직을 내려놓는다.)

According to the National Assembly Act, an impeachment motion against a minister is discarded if not voted on between 24 and 72 hours after being reported to the plenary session. Since this was the final plenary session of the April extraordinary session, the impeachment motion against Minister Jeong is expected to be automatically discarded without a vote. Previously, the People Power Party had requested Speaker Woo Won-shik to convene a plenary session on the 27th, but Speaker Woo did not accept this, leading to the reporting procedure on this day. ( 국민의힘은 즉각 반발했다. 이성권 의원은 페이스북에 글을 올려 “민주당은 (해임요구) 제안을 듣지도 보지도 않았다”며 “야당 의원이 국회 본회의장에서 발언하는데 ‘기념촬영’을 하는 민주당 의원들은 제정신이냐”라고 했다. 이어 “야당에 대한 무시 차원을 넘어 국정을 책임지는 여당 의원들의 품격과 자격의 문제”라며 “오늘 본회의장에서 보인 민주당의 태도는 자격 미달을 넘어 대한민국의 국격을 훼손시킨 망동이다. 반드시 국민의 준엄한 심판을 받아야 할 것”이라고 덧붙였다. )

The People Power Party submitted the impeachment motion on the 24th, arguing that Minister Jeong had damaged the South Korea-U.S. alliance with his "North Korean nuclear facilities in Kusong, North Pyongan Province" remarks. ( 장관 해임건의안은 국회법에 따라 본회의에 보고된 때부터 24시간 이후 72시간 이내 표결하지 않으면 폐기된다. 이날이 4월 임시회 마지막 본회의라 정 장관 해임안은 표결에 부치지 못한 채 자동 폐기될 전망이다. 앞서 국민의힘은 우원식 국회의장에게 27일 본회의를 열어달라고 요청했지만, 우 의장이 이를 수용하지 않으면서 이날 보고 절차를 밟았다. )

Journalist Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr ( 국민의힘은 정 장관이 ‘평북 구성시 북핵시설 발언’을 해 한-미 동맹을 훼손했다며 지난 24일 해임건의안을 제출했다. )

item.title: Unification Ministry to Decide on Using ‘Joseon’ Instead of ‘North Korea’ After Public Debate (통일부, 북한 대신 ‘조선’ 호칭 사용 여부 “공론화 거쳐 결정할 것”)
item.description:
The Unification Ministry announced on the 28th that it would “carefully decide after a public debate process” regarding the issue of referring to North Korea as the “Democratic People’s Republic of Korea.” Minister of Unification Jeong Dong-young has been using this term, and the Ministry intends to assess public opinion trends before determining its official usage. (통일부가 28일 북한을 ‘조선민주주의인민공화국’으로 호칭하는 문제에 대해 “공론화 과정을 거쳐 신중히 판단하겠다”고 밝혔다. 정동영 통일부 장관은 이 용어를 사용해 왔는데, 이에 대한 여론 추이를 살펴본 뒤 공식 사용 여부를 결정하겠다는 뜻이다.)

A Unification Ministry official, responding to reporters’ questions on the 28th about the Ministry’s policy on using the country name “Joseon,” stated that “it will be determined through public debate via various channels.” The official added that there is “no fixed policy” on the term for North Korea, and “we will not prejudge public acceptance but will proceed carefully through a step-by-step process.” (통일부 관계자는 28일 ‘조선’ 국호 사용에 관한 통일부 방침을 묻는 기자들의 질문에 “다양한 채널을 통한 공론화를 거쳐 정해질 것”이라고 밝혔다. 이 관계자는 북한 호칭에 대해 통일부의 “정해진 방침은 없다”면서 “여론의 수용성도 예단하지 않고 절차를 거쳐가며 신중하게 판단할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Minister Jeong used expressions such as “Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (Joseon)” and “South-Joseon relations” at an academic conference co-hosted by the Unification Ministry’s Korea Institute for National Unification last month. In January of this year, at the Ministry’s New Year’s ceremony, Minister Jeong also stated, “The Lee Jae-myung government respects the system of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea.” The Unification Ministry explained that using North Korea’s official state name is the beginning of mutual respect, and that Minister Jeong raised this agenda from that perspective. (정 장관은 지난달 통일부 통일연구원 공동주최 학술회의에서 ‘조선민주주의인민공화국(조선)’, ‘한·조 관계’ 등의 표현을 사용했다. 정 장관은 올해 1월 통일부 시무식에서도 “이재명 정부는 조선민주주의인민공화국의 체제를 존중한다”고 밝힌 바 있다. 통일부는 북한의 국호를 쓰는 것은 상호 존중의 시작이고 정 장관도 그런 측면에서 의제를 던진 것이라고 설명하고 있다.)

The Unification Ministry plans to make a decision by gathering opinions from experts and the public through academic conferences and public opinion surveys. A special academic conference titled “Calling Names for Peaceful Coexistence: North Korea or Joseon,” hosted by the Korean Political Science Association and sponsored by the Unification Ministry on the 29th, is expected to serve as the starting point. At this conference, professors Kim Seong-kyung from Sogang University, lawyer Kwon Eun-min, and professor Lee Dong-ki from Kangwon National University will present discussions on the impact of using North Korea’s official state name on perceptions and attitudes in inter-Korean relations, as well as constitutional and international legal issues. (통일부는 학술회의와 여론조사 등을 통해 전문가와 국민 의견을 청취해 결정할 방침이다. 오는 29일 한국정치학회가 주최하고 통일부가 후원하는 ‘평화공존을 위한 이름 부르기: 북한인가 조선인가’ 특별학술회의가 그 출발점이 될 것으로 보인다. 이날 학술회의에서는 김성경 서강대 교수, 권은민 변호사, 이동기 강원대 교수가 발표를 맡아 북한 공식 국호 사용이 남북관계 인식과 태도에 끼치는 영향과 헌법 및 국제법적 쟁점 등을 논의한다.)

However, experts point out that even if the Unification Ministry raises this issue for public debate and gathers public opinion through forums, the final decision must be formally made across the government after discussions among relevant ministries, including the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of National Defense, and the National Intelligence Service, coordinated by the presidential office. (다만 통일부가 토론회 등을 통해 이 문제를 공론화하고 여론을 수렴하더라도, 최종 결정은 청와대가 외교부·국방부·국정원 등 관련 부처들의 논의를 거쳐 범정부적으로 공식 결정해야 한다고 전문가들은 지적한다.)

Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (박민희 기자 minggu@hani.co.kr 장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party: "Lawmakers with Three or More Terms in Same District Face Up to 15% Deduction if Running Again" (국힘 “동일 지역구 3선 이상 의원, 이번에 또 나오면 최대 15% 감점”)
item.description:
The People Power Party has decided to deduct up to 15% from the primary vote percentage for lawmakers who have served three or more terms in the same district and run again in that district during the screening process for the June 3 by-elections. This is to encourage newcomers to enter politics. (국민의힘이 6·3 국회의원 재보궐선거 공천 심사 때 한 지역구에서 3선 이상 한 의원이 다시 해당 지역에 출마할 경우, 경선 득표율의 최대 15%를 감산하기로 했다. 신인들의 정계 진출을 장려하기 위해서다.)

Park Deok-heum, chairman of the People Power Party's Nomination Management Committee, announced this at a briefing held at the party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, on the 28th, stating that the committee had decided on the criteria for additions and deductions in the by-election primaries. (박덕흠 국민의힘 공천관리위원장은 28일 서울 여의도 중앙당사에서 브리핑을 열고 재보궐 경선 때 가·감산점 기준을 의결했다며 이렇게 밝혔다.)

Chairman Park said, "For lawmakers who have served three or more terms in the same district, we decided to deduct 15% of the primary vote percentage in a two-way race and 10% in a race with three or more candidates." For candidates who have repeatedly lost three or more times in the same district and are considered to have low competitiveness, a deduction of 30% applies in a two-way race and 20% in a race with three or more candidates. (박 위원장은 “동일 지역에서 3선 이상 국회의원 역임 시 양자 대결 기준 경선 득표율의 15%를, 3자 이상 대결 기준 10%를 감산하기로 했다”고 말했다. 동일 지역구에서 3회 이상 반복적으로 낙선해 경쟁력이 낮은 것으로 여겨지는 후보는 양자 대결 기준 30%, 3자 이상 대결 땐 20%를 감산한다.)

Under these criteria, former lawmaker Chung Jin-suk, who has been mentioned as a potential candidate for the by-election in Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang, South Chungcheong Province, would also be subject to a deduction. For bonus points, if a newcomer is a young person, up to 15 points are added in a two-way race, and up to 10 points for a newcomer who is a woman or a person with a disability. When asked about the possibility of drafting former lawmaker Yoo Seong-min for the by-election in Gap, Hanam, Gyeonggi Province, Chairman Park said, "I cannot say now, but I can tell you that we are looking for a candidate who can win." The Nomination Management Committee announced that for nine of the 14 constituencies expected to hold by-elections where nominations have not yet been made, it aims to complete nominations by the 5th of next month. (이 기준에 따르면 충남 공주·부여·청양 보궐선거 출마설이 언급되는 정진석 전 의원도 감산 대상이 된다. 가점의 경우 신인 청년이면 양자대결에서 최대 15점이 정량 가산되고, 신인 여성과 신인 장애인은 최대 10점이 더해진다. 박 위원장은 경기 하남갑 보궐선거에 유승민 전 의원 차출 가능성을 묻는 말에는 “지금 여기서 말할 수는 없지만, 이길 수 있는 후보를 찾고 있다는 것은 말씀드릴 수 있다”고 했다. 공관위는 이번 재보궐선거가 치러질 것으로 예상되는 선거구 14곳 중 아직 공천이 이뤄지지 않은 9곳에 대해서는 다음달 5일까지 공천을 끝내겠다고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, the Nomination Management Committee announced on the same day that candidate Ahn Kyo-jae has been confirmed as the candidate for mayor of Suwon Special City. Candidate Park Tae-kyung was selected as the candidate for mayor of Hwaseong Special City. The primary reflected the results of a voter poll conducted from April 26 to 27 and a general public opinion survey, each weighted at 50%. (한편 공관위는 이날 경기 수원특례시장 후보로 안교재 후보가 확정됐다고 밝혔다. 화성특례시장 후보로는 박태경 후보가 선출됐다. 경선은 4월26일부터 27일까지 실시된 선거인단 투표와 일반 국민 여론조사 결과를 각 50% 비율로 반영했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Seong-tae of Ssangbangwool: "I Have Never Met Lee Jae-myung" (쌍방울 김성태 “이재명 만난 적 없다”)
item.description:
Kim Seong-tae, former chairman of Ssangbangwool, who is on trial for the company's illegal cross-border remittance case, denied allegations of conspiring with President Lee Jae-myung in the illegal remittance to North Korea during a parliamentary inquiry hearing on the 28th, stating, "I have never met then-Gyeonggi Province Governor Lee Jae-myung." The former chairman, referring to President Lee as "that person," became emotional and said, "I am sorry for causing trouble to him," adding, "I am atoning." (쌍방울 대북송금 사건으로 기소돼 재판 중인 김성태 전 쌍방울 회장이 28일 국회 국정조사 청문회에서 “이재명 당시 경기도지사를 만난 적이 없다”며 이재명 대통령과 불법 대북송금을 공모했다는 의혹을 부인했다. 김 전 부회장은 이 대통령을 ‘그분’이라고 지칭하며 “누가 돼 죄송스럽다”고 울먹이기도 했다.)

Former Chairman Kim appeared as a witness at the final comprehensive hearing of the special parliamentary committee investigating allegations of political meddling and fabricated indictments by the Yoon Seok-yeol administration's prosecutors. Kim is currently detained and on trial for allegedly paying 5 million dollars for Gyeonggi Province's smart farm support project in North Korea and 3 million dollars for President Lee's visit to the North on behalf of the provincial government while Lee was its governor. (김 전 회장은 이날 국회에서 열린 ‘윤석열 정권 정치검찰 조작기소 의혹 사건 진상규명 국정조사 특별위원회’의 마지막 종합청문회에 증인으로 나왔다. 김 전 회장은 이 대통령이 경기지사일 때 경기도의 북한 스마트팜 지원 사업비 500만달러와 이 대통령 방북 비용 300만달러를 북한 쪽에 대신 지급했다는 혐의로 구속기소돼 재판받고 있다.)

In response to a question from Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Geon-tae about whether he conspired with President Lee, Kim said, "Lee Hwa-young, former Gyeonggi Province vice governor for peace, is involved, but regarding 'that person,' I have not seen anything, received any compensation, or had any dealings, so I denied being an accomplice during the Suwon District Court trial." He added, "I am sorry and ashamed for causing trouble to someone I admire. I am atoning. (That person) has been the hero of my life. I am a former Democrat." When asked by People Power Party lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun, "Did you ever meet President Lee Jae-myung at the time of the incident?" he replied, "No." (김 전 회장은 이 대통령과의 공모 여부를 묻는 이건태 더불어민주당 의원의 물음에 “이화영 전 경기도 평화부지사는 관계되는데 ‘그분’에 대한 것은 제가 본 것도 없고 대가를 받은 것도 없고 상대를 안 했기 때문에 (수원지법 재판 과정에서) 공범을 부인했다”며 “좋아하는 분에게 누가 돼 죄송스럽고 창피하다. 속죄하고 있다. (그분은) 제 평생 마음속 영웅이었다. 내가 민주당 했던 사람이다”라고 말했다. 그는 ‘사건 당시 이재명 대통령을 만난 적 있느냐’는 윤상현 국민의힘 의원의 물음에 “없다”고 했다.)

Kim claimed that the prosecution had already predetermined its target and that he suffered due to what he called the prosecution's "dust-sweeping investigation." (김 전 회장은 “검찰의 목표는 정해져 있었다”며 검찰의 ‘먼지털기식 수사’로 고초를 겪었다고 주장했다.)

Kim said, "The prosecution arrested nearly 17 people, including my family members and colleagues. They took in my younger brother, my sister's husband, my cousin, and colleagues I've worked with for 30 years." He continued, "Just hearing the word 'prosecution' makes my whole body tremble; I've written several suicide notes. In the Joseon era, wouldn't there have been unjust victims among those executed by executioners? Those who haven't experienced it will never understand." (김 전 회장은 “검찰이 제 가족들, 동료들 등 17명 가까운 사람들을 구속했다. 친동생, 여동생 남편, 사촌 형, 30년 같이했던 동료들 전부 다 잡아넣었다”며 “검찰의 ‘검’자만 나와도 사지가 떨려 유서도 몇번 썼다. 조선시대 망나니한테 죽은 사람 중에 억울한 사람이 없었겠나. 경험하지 못한 사람들은 절대 모를 일이다”라고 말했다.)

Regarding allegations that he, former Vice Governor Lee Hwa-young, and prosecutor Park Sang-yong held a salmon sashimi drinking party in the Suwon District Prosecutors' Office investigation room, Kim denied it, saying, "On May 17 (2023), I definitely did not drink alcohol." When asked by People Power Party lawmaker Kwak Kyu-taek, "Did a Ssangbangwool employee bring soju in a PET bottle into the prosecution office and drink it during a meal?" Kim replied, "When I go in for daily interrogations, I'm tied up with ropes and handcuffed—how could I be served by my employees there?" (김 전 회장은 자신과 이화영 전 부지사, 박상용 검사 등이 수원지검 조사실에서 연어회 술 파티를 했다는 의혹과 관련해서는 “(2023년) 5월17일 정확히 술 안 먹었다”고 부인했다. 그는 ‘쌍방울 직원이 페트병에 소주를 담아 검찰청 안으로 들고 가 식사하며 소주를 마셨느냐’는 곽규택 국민의힘 의원 질문에 “매일매일 조사받으러 가면서 밧줄 꽁꽁 묶여서 수갑 차고 가면 무슨 거기서 저희 직원들한테 수발을 받느냐”고 말했다.)

The Democratic Party plans to hold a full committee meeting on the 30th to adopt the final report of the parliamentary inquiry. (민주당은 오는 30일 특위 전체회의를 열어 국조 결과보고서를 채택할 예정이다.)

item.title: Kim Keon-hee convicted of stock manipulation, sentenced to 4 years in prison on appeal [Gongdeokpocha] (주가조작 ‘유죄’로 뒤집힌 김건희…2심서 징역 4년 [공덕포차])
item.description:
First lady Kim Keon-hee, who faced charges of stock manipulation in Deutsche Motors, was sentenced to four years in prison in an appellate trial held on the 28th. Kim was charged with: participation in the manipulation of Deutsche Motors' stock prices between 2010 and 2012; conspiring with "Fortune-telling Master" Jeon Seong-bae from April to July 2022 to receive church-related requests and bribes from the Unification Church; and receiving free opinion polls from Myung Tae-kyun from June 2021 to March 2022, as well as interfering with nominations for the People Power Party. In the first trial, she had been sentenced to one year and eight months in prison. (도이치모터스 주가조작 혐의 등을 받는 김건희 여사가 28일 열린 항소심에서 징역 4년을 선고받았습니다. 김 여사는 △2010년~2012년 도이치모터스 주가조작 가담 △2022년 4~7월 ‘건진법사’ 전성배씨와 공모해 통일교 쪽으로부터 교단 청탁 및 금품 수수 △2021년 6월~2022년 3월 명태균씨로부터 여론조사 무상 수수 및 국민의힘 공천 개입 혐의로 재판에 넘겨졌는데요. 지난 1심에서는 징역 1년8개월이 선고된 바 있습니다.)

Ha Jung-woo, the senior presidential secretary for AI Future at the Blue House, tendered his resignation on the 27th. As Ha has decided to run in the upcoming by-election in Busan Buk-gu Gap, a fierce competition with former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon is anticipated. (하정우 청와대 AI미래기획 수석이 지난 27일 청와대에 사의를 표했는데요. 하 수석이 이번 부산 북구갑 보궐선거에 출마를 결심한 만큼 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표와의 치열한 승부가 전망됩니다.)

Why did the appellate court for Kim Keon-hee impose a harsher sentence than the first trial? What capabilities will Ha Jung-woo, who is leaving the Blue House, demonstrate as a politician in the future? How long can People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk endure the mounting calls for his resignation from both inside and outside the party? We explore these questions on . Let's check the video! item.title: Prime Minister Kim Min-seok: "30 Trillion Won Budget for Youth Policy...5 Areas Including Jobs" (김민석 총리 “청년정책에 30조 예산 투입…일자리 등 5개 분야”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 28th, "It seems that young people feel the lowest level of policy effectiveness in their lives compared to other citizens," and announced that 30 trillion won would be invested in five areas—jobs, education, housing, finance, and participation—related to youth policy. (김민석 국무총리가 28일 “청년들이 삶에서 느끼는 정책 체감도가 다른 국민에 비해 가장 낮은 것 같다”며 청년정책과 관련해 일자리·교육·주거·금융·참여 등 5개 분야에 30조원의 예산을 투입한다고 밝혔다.)

Prime Minister Kim made these remarks while unveiling the "2026 Central Administrative Agency Youth Policy Implementation Plan" at the Youth Policy Coordination Committee and Youth Policy Ministerial Meeting held in Mapo-gu, Seoul. Kim said, "Although there are many youth policies, there are many raising the issue that they don't actually resonate. We need to discover realistic and tangible projects," and urged, "Ministries and local governments should meticulously ensure that the implementation plan connects to detailed project plans." (김 총리는 이날 서울 마포구에서 열린 청년정책조정위원회 겸 청년정책관계장관회의에서 ‘2026년 중앙행정기관 청년정책 시행계획’을 공개하며 이같이 말했다. 김 총리는 “청년정책이 많지만 실제로 와 닿지 않는다는 문제 제기가 많이 있다. 현실적이고 체감도 있는 사업을 발굴해야 한다”며 “부처와 지자체는 시행계획이 세부적인 사업계획으로 연결될 수 있도록 꼼꼼히 추진해 달라”고 당부했다.)

Prime Minister Kim added, "Regarding the strengthening of the youth policy implementation system that the President recently mentioned, let's also review and discuss it together in the bipartisan youth committee. We need to contemplate the governance issues of our youth policy." President Lee had previously pointed out at a public institution business report on the 17th, "One of the most serious problems in our society right now is the youth issue, yet there is no dedicated research organization." (김 총리는 “최근 대통령께서 말씀하신 청년정책 추진체계 강화와 관련해서도 여야 청년위원회에서 검토하고 함께 논의해 나가자”며 “청년정책에 대한 우리의 거버넌스 문제를 고민해야 한다”고 덧붙였다. 이 대통령은 지난 17일 공공기관 업무보고에서 “지금 우리 사회에서 가장 심각한 문제 중 하나가 청년 문제인데 전담 연구조직이 없다”고 지적한 바 있다.)

The government especially plans to strengthen job-seeking support for idle youth (ages 15-29) and provide work experience to about 45,000 people through collaboration with the public and private sectors. It will also expand the allowances and target number of participants in the National Employment Support System and support vocational training in high-tech and digital fields. Additionally, support will be strengthened for youth leaving protective facilities and youth moving from non-metropolitan areas. Nationwide, 17 metropolitan local governments will invest 6.4 trillion won across 1,563 projects for youth this year. (정부는 특히 쉬고 있는 청년(15∼29세)에 대한 구직 활동 지원을 강화하고, 민관과 협업해 4만5천여명에 일 경험을 제공하기로 했다. 국민취업지원제도의 수당과 대상인원도 확대하고, 첨단산업·디지털 분야의 직업훈련도 지원한다. 외에도 보호시설 퇴소 청년 및 비수도권 이동 청년에 대한 지원도 강화하기로 했다. 전국 17개 광역지자체는 올해 청년을 위해 1563개 사업에 6조4천억원의 예산을 투입한다.)

Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Each Ministry Should Discover Productive Public Service Jobs" (이 대통령 “각 부처에서 생산적 공공서비스 일자리 발굴해 달라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 28th stated, "In an era of job scarcity, South Korea has both poor quality and insufficient quantity of jobs in the public service sector," and instructed, "Each ministry should discover productive public service jobs." (이재명 대통령이 28일 “일자리가 부족한 시대에 대한민국은 공공서비스 영역의 일자리의 질도 별로고 양도 많지 않다”며 “각 부처에서 생산적인 공공서비스 일자리를 발굴해 달라”고 지시했다.)

Presiding over a cabinet meeting combined with the 6th Emergency Economic Review Meeting at Cheong Wa Dae, President Lee said, "I'm not asking to hire thousands or tens of thousands, but if there are opportunities, please conduct a thorough investigation at the ministry, office, and bureau levels and look into them," adding, "Even five or ten people are fine. If we gather them up, it becomes a huge number." <<> President Lee cited the National Tax Service's Delinquent Tax Collection Team and industrial site safety watchers as examples of public service jobs where employment can be increased. <<> Referring to the National Tax Service's additional hiring of the Delinquent Tax Collection Team as a successful case in collecting delinquent national taxes, President Lee said, "Over 100 trillion won in back taxes is owed... If we collect just 10% of that, that's 10 trillion won," and noted, "Hiring 10,000 people in the collection team would cost 500 billion won. Even hiring just 10 people wouldn't be a loss." <<> President Lee emphasized, "(Additional hiring in the social safety sector) is not a financial loss even from an economic standpoint. (Korea) has many industrial accidents and suicides, which is internationally embarrassing," adding, "We are increasing labor inspectors and deploying public safety management teams, but there are many more such types of tasks. Additional hiring of personnel to prevent accidents in the social safety sector is urgent." President Lee explained that expanding public service jobs ultimately benefits society. He said, "When we do this, some may say we're just throwing money around, but (the government is actually) spending money wisely," and added, "We can secure social benefits far higher than the (public service job) pay." <<> Concerning the recent spate of violations of teaching authority, President Lee instructed, "Normalizing public education starts with guaranteeing not only students' but also teachers' human rights and authority. Please quickly devise measures and solutions to strengthen the protection of teaching authority." Regarding the trend of avoiding external activities such as school trips and picnics, he said, "It's probably due to concerns about safety accidents or management responsibility. You shouldn't remove the kimchi jar just because you're worried about maggots appearing," and advised, "We need to resolve the issue by providing additional funding to reinforce safety personnel or by recruiting volunteers." <<> On revitalizing the stock market, President Lee stated, "We're still at the level of picking out a few big stones; now we need to pick out the small stones. Isn't our market still significantly undervalued?" The KOSPI closed at 6,641.02 that day, hitting a new record high for the second consecutive day. <<> Regarding corporate social responsibility, President Lee said, "India mandates companies above a certain revenue threshold to use 2% of net profit for social contributions," and added, "Please find a way for the public to easily know (the extent of each company's social contribution spending) to encourage this." <<> Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 국무회의 겸 6차 비상경제점검회의를 주재하며 “수천, 수만명을 고용하라는 게 아니라 있으면 하되, 각 부처·실·국 단위로 엄밀히 조사해서 챙겨봐 달라”며 “5명, 10명도 상관없다. 그걸 모으면 엄청나게 많다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Jung: “Oh Se-hoon’s Hasty Lifting of Land Transaction Permit System Caused Chaos” – Oh: “Jung Won-oh, Even Dividing Single-Home Owners” (정 “오세훈, 토허제 즉흥해제 혼란”-오 “정원오, 1주택자도 갈라치기”)
item.description:
On the 28th, the day after Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor in the June 3 local elections, registered as a preliminary candidate and officially jumped into the election race, Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate for Seoul mayor, ramped up his offensive by championing a “judgment against Oh Se-hoon” narrative. The two candidates also engaged in a fierce exchange over real estate policies, including the controversy surrounding the “Long-Term Holding Special Deduction.” (6·3 지방선거 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 예비후보로 등록한 다음날인 28일 본격적으로 선거전에 뛰어들자, 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보는 ‘오세훈 심판론’을 앞세워 공세 수위를 한껏 끌어올렸다. 두 후보는 ‘장기보유특별공제’(장특공제) 논란 등 부동산 정책을 두고도 난타전을 이어갔다.)

Candidate Jung held his first public campaign committee meeting that day at his election headquarters in Jung-gu, Seoul. The event showcased his strength, with over 30 Democratic Party lawmakers attending, including six co-chairpersons of the standing election committee (Lawmakers In-young Lee, Young-kyo Seo, Ju-min Park, Hyun-hee Jeon, Young-bae Kim, and Kim Hyung-nam, former director of the Military Human Rights Center), as well as Election Headquarters Chief Lee Hae-sik, Joint Election Headquarters Chief Oh Ki-hyung, General Situation Headquarters Chief Chae Hyun-il, and Oh Se-hoon’s 10-Year Judgment Headquarters Chief Koh Min-jung. (정 후보는 이날 서울 중구에 있는 선거대책위원회 사무실에서 첫 공개 선대위 회의를 열었다. 6명의 상임선대위원장(이인영·서영교·박주민·전현희·김영배 의원, 김형남 전 군인권센터 사무국장)을 비롯해 이해식 총괄선대본부장과 오기형 공동선대본부장, 채현일 종합상황본부장, 고민정 오세훈 10년 심판본부장 등 민주당 의원 30여명이 참석해 세를 과시했다.)

“Mayor Oh Se-hoon’s first words right after being selected as a candidate were truly disappointing,” Jung began, adding, “He couldn’t say a single word against the incompetence and recklessness of the Yoon Seok-youl administration, but now he’s picking a fight with the capable Lee Jae-myung administration.” This was a direct jab at Oh, who had previously worn a white jacket but, after registering as a preliminary candidate the day before, donned a red jacket—the color of the People Power Party—and declared, “I will not stand by and watch the Lee Jae-myung administration’s unilateral rule.” (“오세훈 시장의 후보 선출 직후 첫 일성은 참으로 실망스러웠다”고 말문을 연 정 후보는 “윤석열 정부의 무능과 폭주 앞에서는 제대로 말 한마디 하지 못하더니, 이제 일 잘하는 이재명 정부를 향해 시비를 걸고 있다”고 말했다. 오 후보는 그동안 흰색 점퍼를 입다가 전날 예비후보로 등록한 뒤 국민의힘 색깔인 빨간색 점퍼를 입고 “이재명 정부의 독주를 좌시하지 않겠다”고 했는데 이를 직격한 것이다.)

Jung further criticized, “The very person who impulsively lifted the land transaction permit system in Seoul, only to reverse it in 35 days and cause market chaos, is now shifting the blame to the government—that doesn’t make sense. He also brings up tax issues every election season, stoking anxiety and escalating real estate conflicts.” This referred to Oh’s decision in February 2025 to lift the land transaction permit system in three affluent Gangnam districts, which triggered real estate market instability. A Jung campaign official said of the intensified attack on Oh, “Now it’s a one-on-one race. We’ll emphasize our edge over Oh in policy differentiation and administrative competence.” (정 후보는 “정작 서울의 토지거래허가제를 즉흥적으로 풀었다가 35일 만에 번복하며 시장 혼란을 키운 장본인이 이제 와 그 책임을 정부에 돌리는 것도 앞뒤가 맞지 않는다”며 “선거 때마다 세금 문제를 꺼내 불안을 자극하고 부동산 갈등을 키운다”고도 했다. 오 후보가 2025년 2월 강남 3구 토지거래허가제를 해제했다가 부동산 시장 불안을 야기한 것을 꼬집은 것이다. 오 후보에 대해 공세 수위를 올린 것에 대해 정 후보 쪽 관계자는 “이제 일대일 구도가 됐다. 오 후보와 정책적 차별성, 행정 능력에서 우위란 걸 강조할 것이다”고 했다.)

On the same day, Oh, who had registered as a preliminary candidate the previous day, wore a red jacket and began his first schedule by boarding a bus at 4 a.m. to meet citizens, including sanitation workers. He highlighted the “Dawn Companion Autonomous Bus,” introduced on crowded early-morning routes, as a policy achievement. Oh also launched the “Seoul Special City for Quality of Life Election Committee,” composed of 12 citizens who had experienced changes in their lives under his administration. (전날 예비후보로 등록한 오 후보는 이날부터 빨간색 점퍼를 입고 첫 일정으로 새벽 4시 출근길 버스에 탑승해 청소노동자 등 시민들을 만났다. 첫차 혼잡 노선을 중심으로 도입된 ‘새벽동행 자율주행버스’를 부각하며 자신의 정책 성과를 강조한 것이다. 오 후보는 ‘오세훈 시정’으로 삶의 변화를 경험한 시민 12명으로 꾸린 ‘삶의질특별시 서울 선대위’도 출범시켰다.)

At a victory rally held in Yongsan-gu that day, Oh said, “Even if you’re thinking, ‘The People Power Party just fights and I don’t like it, so I won’t vote for them,’ you should leave at least one option—like a leftover persimmon for magpies—so there’s an alternative when President Lee Jae-myung fails.” This highlighted that Jung is “Lee Jae-myung’s pick,” while emphasizing that Oh himself is the right person to check the government and ruling party. (오 후보는 이날 용산구에 열린 필승결의대회에서 “국민의힘이 요즘 싸우기만 하고 마음에 안 들어서 ‘안 찍어’ 그럴 때, 까치밥 하나 남겨는 놔야 이재명 대통령이 못할 때 대안이 있지 않겠느냐”고 했다. 정 후보가 ‘명픽’(이재명 대통령의 선택)이라는 점을 부각하며 자신이 정부·여당을 견제할 적임자라는 것을 강조한 것이다.)

Oh’s camp also attacked Jung on the same day, leveraging the controversy over the revision of the Long-Term Holding Special Deduction (a system that deducts up to 80% of capital gains by combining the holding period—up to 40%—and the residence period—up to 40% for long-term single-home owners). The Lee Jae-myung administration is currently considering revising the system to expand deductions for actual residents and reduce them for non-residents. Lee Chang-geun, a spokesperson for Oh’s campaign, said that day, “Jung, who supports the Lee Jae-myung administration’s clumsy revision of the Long-Term Holding Special Deduction that divides single-home owners into residents and non-residents, has any right to talk about replacing ability? It will become clear who truly cares about citizens’ lives.” (오 후보 쪽은 이날도 장특공제(1주택 장기 보유자에게 보유 기간(최대 40%)과 거주 기간(최대 40%)를 합산해 최대 80% 양도 차익을 깎아주는 제도) 개편 논란을 앞세워 정 후보를 공격했다. 이재명 정부는 현재 실거주자는 감면을 확대하고, 비거주자는 감면을 축소하는 제도 개편을 검토 중이다. 이창근 오 후보 선대위 대변인은 이날 “1세대 1주택자를 거주와 비거주로 갈라치기하는 이재명 정부의 어설픈 장특공제 개편에 동조하는 정 후보야말로 실력 교체를 말할 자격이 있는가. 누가 진짜 시민의 삶을 챙기는지 드러날 것”이라고 말했다.)

In response, Jung said, “I’ve stated that the current rights of actual resident single-home owners must be unconditionally protected. If they distort facts and incite conflict through false propaganda, they won’t escape the stern judgment of the citizens.” (이에 대해 정 후보는 “실거주 1가구 1주택자의 현행 권리는 무조건 보호돼야 한다고 했다. 사실을 왜곡하고 허위 선동으로 갈등을 조장한다면 시민의 준엄한 심판을 피할 수 없을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Choi Ha-yan and Yoo Young-jae reporters chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 유영재 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk Squabble Over Pyeongtaek B (‘평택을 맞짱’ 김용남·조국 신경전)
item.description:
As the Democratic Party of Korea strategically nominated former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam, a former "Cho Kuk sniper" from a conservative party, as its candidate for the June 3 by-election in Pyeongtaek B, the Rebuilding Korea Party, which had already put forward leader Cho Kuk as its candidate for Pyeongtaek B, has been openly uncomfortable, dredging up Kim's past "outrageous remarks." (더불어민주당이 보수 정당 출신의 과거 ‘조국 저격수’ 김용남 전 의원을 6·3 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거 후보로 전략공천하자, 이미 평택을 후보로 조국 대표를 내세운 조국혁신당이 김 후보의 과거 ‘망언’을 꺼내 들며 불편함을 숨기지 않고 있다.)

In an interview on YTN Radio's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang" on the 28th, Kim said about his attacks on Cho during the 2019 "Cho Kuk scandal," "Even looking at the situation now, there are clearly problems," adding, "It was a situation where anyone would have had no choice but to point out the issues." He continued, "Regarding the so-called Cho Kuk private equity fund, the more (Cho's side) talks about it, the more disadvantageous it becomes for Cho," and "If they don't attack first, I won't attack." <<> The Rebuilding Party, which has argued that the Democratic Party should not nominate a candidate for the Pyeongtaek B by-election triggered by the loss of Democratic lawmaker Lee Byeong-jin's seat, is visibly displeased. <<> In particular, there is a prevailing sentiment that nominating Kim, who previously launched offensives against Cho, violates "political propriety." Following the announcement of Kim's nomination the previous day, Senior Election Strategy Committee Chair Jeong Chun-saeng wrote, "Is the Democratic Party, which nominated a Cho Kuk sniper, truly an ally in building the Lee Jae-myung administration?" adding, "They're out to kill Cho, so what can we do? We have no choice but to fight with all our might to survive." <<> Rebuilding Party Election Campaign Chair Kang Kyung-sook also on Facebook recalled five of Kim's past remarks, stating, "Kim has shown a rapid shift in political stance, raw criticism of opponents, and behavior that denies his own statements." Kang referenced Kim's defense of then-candidate Yoon Suk-yeol, who in a 2021 presidential debate appeared with the Chinese character for "king" written on his palm, saying, "It seems he mainly washed his fingers," as well as Kim's 2015 comment that the Sewol Ferry Special Investigation Committee was a "waste of taxes." <<> The Democratic Party appears to be drawing a line regarding discussions of unification with Cho's faction. Secretary-General Jo Seung-rae appeared on SBS Radio on the same day, stating, "We will win under the name of Kim Yong-nam, under the name of the Democratic Party." <<> Reporter Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr ( 김 후보는 28일 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’ 인터뷰에서 2019년 ‘조국 사태’ 당시 조 후보를 공격했던 것을 두고 “지금 상황에 봐도 분명히 문제가 있을 것”이라며 “누가 봐도 충분히 문제를 지적할 수밖에 없는 상황이었다”고 말했다. 이어 “이른바 조국 사모펀드 관련해선 (조 후보 쪽이) 얘기를 하면 할수록 조 후보에게 불리해질 수밖에 없다”며 “저쪽에서 먼저 공격하지 않으면 저는 공격 안 한다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Both the Democratic Party and the People Power Party Wrestle with Candidate Unification (민주당도, 국힘도 모두 단일화 ‘골머리’)
item.description:
<<>> With the June 3 local and by-elections just 36 days away, the issue of candidate unification is emerging as a key variable that could determine each party's victory or defeat. ()

On the 28th, as former Reform Party lawmaker Cho Eung-cheon declared his candidacy, the Gyeonggi Province governor race took on a multi-candidate format. At a press conference held at the National Assembly, Cho emphasized, "Set aside the mismatched answer sheets of bad and odd candidates, and cast your vote for good candidate Cho Eung-cheon as Gyeonggi Province governor." Earlier, the Democratic Party of Korea had confirmed Rep. Choo Mi-ae as its candidate, while the People Power Party is holding a primary among Supreme Council member Yang Hyang-ja, former lawmaker Ham Jin-gyu, and former announcer Lee Seong-bae. The People Power Party will finalize its candidate on the 2nd of next month. ( 6·3 지방선거·재보궐선거가 36일 앞으로 다가오면서 후보 단일화 여부가 각 당 승패를 가를 핵심 변수가 되고 있다. )

With many opinion polls showing the People Power Party trailing the Democratic Party, the need for unification within the conservative camp is repeatedly raised. A People Power Party lawmaker from Gyeonggi Province told The Hankyoreh on this day, "To shake up the skewed playing field, unification among conservative candidates is inevitable." Supreme Council member Yang, who is also in the primary, stated, "If we share the goal of stopping the ruling party's runaway dominance, there is no reason to close the door on discussions." However, Cho expressed his intention to complete the race, saying he sees "no reason" to unify with the People Power Party candidate. ( 28일 개혁신당 소속 조응천 전 의원이 출마를 선언하면서 경기지사 선거는 다자 구도로 대진표가 짜였다. 조 전 의원은 이날 국회에서 출마 기자회견을 열고 “나쁜 후보와 이상한 후보의 어긋난 답안지를 내려놓고, 좋은 후보 조응천을 경기도지사로 써달라”고 강조했다. 앞서 더불어민주당은 추미애 의원을 후보로 확정했고, 국민의힘에서는 양향자 최고위원, 함진규 전 의원, 이성배 전 아나운서가 경선을 치르고 있다. 국민의힘은 새달 2일 최종 후보를 결정한다. )

The situation is further complicated in the by-election for Pyeongtaek Gap in Gyeonggi Province, where former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam was strategically nominated as the Democratic Party candidate the previous day, as it intersects with unification efforts in other regions. While candidate Kim is expected to enter discussions on pan-opposition unification with former Justice Party leader Cho Kuk (who has already declared his candidacy) and Progressive Party co-leader Kim Jae-yeon, for now, the candidates seem to be engaged only in a fierce war of nerves. The Progressive Party had sought to leverage the unification of the Ulsan mayoral candidate, aiming to field Kim Jae-yeon as the unified progressive candidate in that region, but Cho's candidacy has complicated its calculations. ( 다수 여론조사에서 국민의힘이 민주당에 뒤지는 흐름이라, 보수 진영에선 단일화 필요성이 거듭 거론된다. 경기 지역 국민의힘 한 의원은 이날 한겨레에 “기울어진 판세를 흔들려면 보수 후보 간 단일화가 불가피하다”고 말했다. 경선 중인 양 최고위원도 “여당 독주 저지라는 목표를 함께한다면 논의를 닫을 이유가 없다”고 했다. 다만 조 전 의원은 국민의힘 후보와 단일화하는 방안에 대해 “할 이유가 없다”며 완주 의지를 드러냈다. )

In the Ulsan mayoral election, unification is a key issue for both the progressive and conservative camps. Although Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Sang-uk holds a lead, observers suggest the landscape could shift depending on how candidates are consolidated within each camp. If the conservative camp—comprising incumbent Mayor Kim Doo-gyeom of the People Power Party and former Mayor Park Maeng-woo, who left the party—succeeds in unifying, it could narrow the gap with the Democratic Party. Conversely, if candidate Kim Sang-uk unifies with Progressive Party's former Ulsan Dong-gu District Mayor Kim Jong-hoon, there is hopeful anticipation that they could significantly outpace the conservative candidate and solidify the outcome. ( 전날 김용남 전 의원이 민주당 후보로 전략 공천된 경기 평택을 재선거의 경우 다른 지역 단일화까지 맞물린 터라 상황이 더 복잡하다. 김 후보는 앞서 출마 선언한 조국 조국혁신당 대표, 김재연 진보당 상임대표 등과 범여권 단일화 논의에 나설 것으로 보이지만 현재로선 후보 간 신경전만 치열하게 이어지는 모양새다. 진보당은 울산시장 후보 단일화를 지렛대로 삼아, 김재연 후보가 이 지역 진보진영 단일 후보로 나서는 방안을 모색해왔지만 조 후보의 출마로 셈법이 더 복잡해졌다. )

However, unification discussions in both camps are not progressing. A Democratic Party Ulsan city chapter official said, "Discussions could extend to unification for not only the metropolitan mayor but also basic local government heads and local councilors, making it difficult to align positions." A source from the People Power Party added, "The deep emotional rift between the two candidates makes unification discussions challenging." ( 울산시장 선거의 경우 진보·보수 진영 모두 단일화가 쟁점이다. 민주당 소속 김상욱 의원이 우위인 흐름이지만, 진영 간 후보 정리에 따라 구도가 달라질 것이란 관측이 나온다. 보수 진영인 국민의힘 소속 김두겸 현 시장과 국민의힘에서 탈당한 박맹우 전 시장이 단일화에 성공하면 민주당과 격차를 좁힐 수 있다. 반대로 김상욱 후보와 진보당 김종훈 전 울산 동구청장이 단일화할 경우, 보수 후보를 크게 앞서며 승부를 굳힐 수 있다는 기대감이 표출된다. )

In the Bucheon North Gap National Assembly by-election, unification between the People Power Party candidate and independent former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon is also critical. Within the People Power Party, there are ongoing calls for the party to field no candidate in that district to ensure a conservative victory. ( 다만 두 진영 모두 단일화 논의가 진척되지 않고 있다. 민주당 울산시당 관계자는 “광역단체장뿐 아니라 기초단체장, 지방의원까지 단일화 논의가 확대될 가능성이 있어 입장 정리가 쉽지 않다”고 했다. 국민의힘 쪽은 “양 후보 간 감정 골이 깊어 단일화 논의가 쉽지 않다”고 했다. )

Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr ( 이밖에 부산 북구갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서도 국민의힘 후보와 무소속 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표 간 단일화가 관건이다. 국민의힘 내부에서는 보수 진영의 선거 승리를 위해 해당 지역 무공천 요구가 이어지고 있다. )

item.title: Seo Young-kyo: "Special Counsel Law to Investigate Manipulated Investigations Must Be Processed Within May" (서영교 “조작검사들 수사할 특검법, 5월내 처리해야”)
item.description:
The 'National Assembly Inquiry for Fact-Finding into the Yoon Seok-yeol Administration's Political Prosecution's Alleged Manipulated Indictments' has reached its final stages. The investigation process concluded with the comprehensive hearing on the 28th, leaving only the adoption of the report on the 30th. This marks 41 days since the first plenary session was held on the 20th of last month. (‘윤석열 정권 정치검찰 조작기소 의혹 사건 진상규명을 위한 국회 국정조사’가 막바지에 이르렀다. 28일 종합 청문회를 끝으로 조사 절차는 마무리됐고, 오는 30일 보고서 채택만을 남겨두고 있다. 지난달 20일 첫 전체회의를 연 이래 41일 만이다.)

A major achievement of this inquiry is that it uncovered from multiple angles the various manipulated investigations and indictments by the prosecution under the Yoon Seok-yeol administration, which had previously remained in the realm of suspicion and conjecture. Audio files were released showing Prosecutor Park Sang-yong, who handled the 'Ssangbangwool North Korea Remittance' case, coercing and pressuring a statement of "Lee Jae-myung as the principal offender" by mentioning sentence reductions and investigations of associates. Testimony also emerged for the first time that the second investigation team for the Daejang-dong case pressured witnesses to frame President Lee Jae-myung as an accomplice, saying, "Our goal is just one." The public was also stunned by testimony that the incredible coincidence of Kim Man-bae's sister buying the house of former President Yoon Seok-yeol's father was actually a planned collusion arranged through former Special Counsel Park Young-soo, Yoon's mentor. On the other hand, the People Power Party and prosecutors accused of manipulation claimed this inquiry was an abuse of power by the National Assembly, intervening in investigations and trials to 'build up' a case for dismissing the indictment of President Lee. However, it is doubtful that without this inquiry, the numerous illegal investigative and indictment practices of the prosecution, which only existed as rumors, would have seen even a portion of the light of day. ( 그동안 의혹과 짐작의 영역에 머물러 있던 윤석열 정권 검찰의 각종 조작 수사·기소 실체가 다각도로 파헤쳐진 건 이번 국조의 큰 성과다. ‘쌍방울 대북송금’을 담당했던 박상용 검사가 형량 봐주기와 주변인 수사 가능성 등을 언급하며 “이재명 주범” 진술을 회유·압박한 녹음 파일이 공개됐다. 또 대장동 사건 2차 수사팀이 “우리 목표는 하나”라며 이재명 대통령을 공범으로 엮기 위한 진술을 강압했다는 진술도 처음으로 나왔다. 윤석열 전 대통령의 부친 집을 ‘대장동 민간업자’ 김만배씨 누나가 사준 기막힌 우연이 사실은 윤 전 대통령의 멘토인 박영수 전 국정농단 특검의 소개로 이뤄진 계획된 결탁이라는 증언도 국민을 놀라게 했다. 반면, 국민의힘과 조작 의혹을 받는 검사들은 이번 국조가 이 대통령 공소취소를 ‘빌드업’하기 위해 수사와 재판에 개입한 국회의 권한 남용이라고 주장했다. 그러나 이번 국조가 없었다면 의혹으로만 떠돌던 검찰의 숱한 위법적 수사·기소 행태가 그 일단이라도 햇볕 아래 드러날 수 있었을지 의문이 든다.)

Attention is now focused on how to respond to the wrongdoings of the political prosecution revealed by the inquiry. I met with Seo Young-kyo, Chair of the Special Inquiry Committee, at the National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee Chairman's office on the 24th to ask about the significance of this inquiry and the direction of future responses. ( 이제 관심은 국조로 밝혀진 정치검찰의 잘못에 어떻게 대응할 것인지의 문제로 모아지고 있다. 서영교 국조특위 위원장을 지난 24일 국회 법사위원장실에서 만나 이번 국조의 의미와 이후 대응 방향에 대해 묻고 들었다. )

—You've been running breathlessly for over a month. How do you feel looking back? ( —한 달 넘게 숨 가쁘게 달려왔는데 소회가 어떤가?)

"I felt I was at a historic site following the '5th Republic Chun Doo-hwan Inquiry,' the 'Park Geun-hye State Affairs Scandal Inquiry,' and the 'Yoon Seok-yeol Insurrection Inquiry.' It felt like Korea was witnessing a scene akin to the blockbuster film 'Masquerade,' where King Danjong had to be eliminated for King Sejo to rise. To eliminate Lee Jae-myung so Yoon Seok-yeol could survive. So even after becoming president, Yoon mobilized all state investigation agencies and power organs to try to eliminate political rivals—this was all revealed at that scene." <<> —The People Power Party and some witnesses who are former prosecutors argued that this hearing had a strong purpose of interfering with investigations or trials, making it highly unconstitutional and illegal. <<> "Article 8 of the National Assembly Inspection and Investigation Act states that it should not have the purpose of interfering with ongoing trials or investigations. However, the commentary on the National Assembly Act stipulates that if the National Assembly conducts an inquiry through lawful procedures for the independent purpose of fact-finding, pursuing political responsibility, or collecting legislative materials, investigations and indictments can also be subjects. For this reason, inquiries were possible for Park Geun-hye and Yoon Seok-yeol even while trials and investigations were ongoing. The claims of unconstitutionality and illegality are nothing but political stalling." <<> —There are also criticisms that forming a lawmakers' group initially focused on dismissing the indictment caused unnecessary misunderstandings. <<> "If false evidence emerges, I believe dismissing an indictment is possible, just as a court can dismiss a case during trial. However, expecting political attacks over the indictment dismissal group, we decided to prioritize fact-finding over pushing for dismissal, which led to the establishment of the Fact-Finding Inquiry Committee. I think it was meaningful to first learn the truth and make it known to the world." <<> —The hearings have successively revealed problems with the prosecution's investigations during the Yoon Seok-yeol administration. Did you expect such results when you took on the role as Chair of the Special Inquiry Committee? <<> "Far more was revealed in detail at this hearing than I expected. The first thing that came out was the Park Sang-yong recorded conversation. Right after I became chair, Rep. Jeon Yong-ki came and played the recording, saying, 'Don't tell anyone.' When I was the head of the Myung Tae-kyun Gate Fact-Finding Team, finding Yoon Seok-yeol's recorded comment saying, "Just handle Kim Young-sun for me; there's a lot of talk in the party," was pivotal. The Park Sang-yong recording was indeed deleted from lawyer Seo Min-seok's phone. But when Seo ran in the local election primaries, young aides joined him. These were friends who had worked with Rep. Jeon in the party's youth wing. They found the file remaining in the T-call cloud and reported it to Rep. Jeon." <<> —Was that the moment you felt was the biggest achievement? <<> "Because it was irrefutable audio evidence. Another moment was when we verified that Park Sang-yong's superiors had all called lawyer Seo. Senior Prosecutor Kim Young-nam and even Suwon District Prosecutors' Office Chief Hong Seung-wook made calls. It revealed the entire chain of prosecutorial superiors to whom Park Sang-yong reported daily to make Lee Jae-myung the principal offender. On the Daejang-dong case, I asked Song Kyung-ho (former Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office Chief) if they received daily reports, and he was flustered, saying they received timely reports. So, the routine intervention by the prosecutorial leadership came out of their own mouths." <<> —What moment did you find most absurd or infuriating? <<> "When I heard that Prosecutor Jeong Il-kwon of the 2nd Daejang-dong investigation team, after Nam-wook refused to testify, showed photos of his kids and said something like 'I'll cut open his belly,' I thought it was cowardly. Yet, Prosecutor Jeong saying he showed the photos 'from a humanitarian perspective' really infuriated me. Also, seeing former Chief Song Kyung-ho and former Prosecutor General Lee Won-seok both defending him by saying 'I trust Jeong Il-kwon' was utterly absurd. It's something the whole nation sees as wrong... Lee even said about keeping Nam-wook in detention for 2 nights and 3 days and interrogating him that it was 'better from a human rights protection perspective.' That was just absurd beyond belief." <<> —The scene of Prosecutor Kang Baek-shin glaring and shouting also left a strong impression on the public. <<> "I think it became an opportunity for the public to see the true nature of political prosecutors and judge for themselves." <<> —Regarding the Daejang-dong investigation, testimony emerged for the first time that Prosecutor Jeong Il-kwon told Nam-wook, "Our goal is just one." <<> "I was really shocked. So that's how it was. A prosecutor actually said that out loud. I thought, 'Yes, this is what a parliamentary inquiry is for.'" <<> —Another impactful moment was when Kim Tae-hoon, head of the 1st Daejang-dong investigation team (now Chief of Daejeon High Prosecutors' Office), testified that the 2nd investigation team 'finalized breach-of-trust content by deviating from established Supreme Court precedent principles, aligning with a specific party's frame.' <<> "He must have faced significant internal prosecution backlash, but he testified firmly. He said the 1st investigation team, based on uncontaminated evidence like the 'Jung Young-hak recording transcript,' properly revealed the truth of the Daejang-dong case, but the complete change in investigation direction after the team was fully replaced by the 2nd team was wrong. That part was outstanding to me. Also, if Prosecutor General Kim Tae-hoon hadn't mentioned it, the Dong-A Ilbo report on the 'Daejang-dong gentleman' comment would have been brushed aside as old news. He gave valuable testimony, worthy of being a lesson for future media reports." <<> —Regarding the North Korea remittance case, former Ssangbangwool Vice Chairman Bang Yong-chul maintained his trial testimony that he met North Korea's Ri Ho-nam in the Philippines and delivered dollars. Didn't you expect that answer? <<> "It's so clear that Ri Ho-nam wasn't in the Philippines at the time, so I didn't think he'd say that. I thought he might refuse to testify. The important thing is that witnesses like Kim Kook-heon and Cho Kyung-sik all testified that Ri Ho-nam wasn't there. Also, the Yoon Seok-yeul administration's National Intelligence Service created documents reporting that Ri Ho-nam was in Vietnam and China during that period. I saw that Bang Yong-chul maintained his original claim because Kim Seong-tae hasn't given him an order yet. The moment they withdraw the 'Lee Jae-myung cost for visiting North Korea' claim and tell the truth, the Ssangbangwool stock manipulation issue will spill over. Since the Yoon Seok-yeul prosecution allowed them billions in gains, they'll do anything to protect that. But do you know that Ri Ho-nam's name doesn't appear in the initial indictment of Kim Seong-tae?" <<> —What does that mean? <<> "Ri Ho-nam first appears in the indictment of Lee Hwa-young. Then Lee Jae-myung's indictment mentions Ri Ho-nam. Kim Seong-tae's initial indictment only states giving dollars to Song Myung-chul (deputy director of North Korea's Asia-Pacific Peace Committee). But the Asia-Pacific Peace Committee wasn't a sanctioned entity then, so it seems using Song Myung-chul made direct linkage to Lee Jae-myung inconvenient. So they brought in Ri Ho-nam, who belonged to the Reconnaissance General Bureau, a sanctioned entity. And after a 'statement seminar' in the prosecutor's office, only Bang Yong-chul ended up testifying that Ri Ho-nam was in the Philippines. Initially, Bang Yong-chul testified he gave the money after Ri Ho-nam attended an Asia-Pacific Peace and Prosperity Conference in the Philippines. But when Lee Hwa-young's side said Ri Ho-nam wasn't among the attendees, he panicked and changed his statement, claiming Ri Ho-nam didn't come to the conference hall but he guided him to Kim Seong-tae's room." <<> —The People Power Party said NIS Director Lee Jong-suk's report that 'Ri Ho-nam wasn't in the Philippines' was perjury and threatened to file a complaint. <<> "The People Power Party can file a complaint on its own, but then it will immediately be a false accusation. The Yoon Seok-yeul NIS documents already confirmed Ri Ho-nam was in a third country." <<> —Former presidential office Senior Secretary for Public Discipline Lee Si-won appeared as a witness but refused to testify, citing investigation-related matters. <<> "Lee Si-won's involvement was about whether the North Korean Asia-Pacific Peace Committee was subject to sanctions. The prosecution argues the issue is sending money to a sanctioned entity, but lawyers revealed in court it wasn't a sanctioned entity. The sanctioned entities listed didn't include the committee. So Lee Si-won made critical inquiries to the NIS and Ministry of Economy and Finance, asking 'Why isn't this a sanctioned entity?' Subsequently, it is said a document stating it 'could be a sanctioned entity based on circumstances' was submitted to the court. That's why there's talk of presidential office intervention." <<> —Are you saying Yoon Seok-yeol directly intervened in investigations and trials through his presidential office staff? <<> "In the 'West Sea civil servant shooting incident' manipulation case, former NIS Director Kim Kyu-hyun testified that 'Yoon Seok-yeol directly ordered the complaint against Moon Jae-in administration officials.' Former Deputy National Security Advisor Kim Tae-hyo was also involved." <<> —Is it possible for the inquiry report to be adopted by consensus on the 30th? <<> "The People Power Party probably won't agree. So perhaps we can include even richer content and pass it anyway." <<> —After the Special Inquiry Committee, does it proceed to a special counsel investigation? <<> "Rep. Chung Cheong-rae has consistently discussed a special counsel. The Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials (CIO) can investigate, but considering capabilities, a special counsel seems more appropriate." <<> —Is it possible to pass the special counsel bill within the May parliamentary session? <<> "There's a plenary session on May 7th, primarily for the constitutional amendment vote, but several livelihood bills also need processing. The special counsel bill must first go through the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, so it's tight. It should be processed within May if possible." <<> —There are views that if the special counsel reveals specific manipulation charges, it should lead to dismissing the indictment for the fabricated charges. What do you think? <<> "The Special Inquiry Committee's priority is uncovering the truth. Matters like dismissing indictments come next." <<> —Some in the ruling camp argue that the 'Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Law' should include a provision allowing the special counsel to dismiss indictments, giving the option to proceed with dismissal based on investigation results. <<> "We need to discuss this thoroughly in the future. In cases like statistics manipulation investigations, related officials from the Ministry of Land, etc., feel extremely wronged. If possible, the indictment against those people should be dismissed. However, there is still unnecessary political interpretation, so it's hard to say anything specific now. As the Chair of the Special Inquiry Committee, my role and goal extend to uncovering the truth and holding people accountable. After that, I think new situations may arise with the public, leading to further steps forward." <<> —As Chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, what do you think about the prosecution's 'supplementary investigation authority'? <<> "When officials from the Office for Government Policy Coordination came to discuss it, I was clear. 'Supplementary investigation authority is not allowed.' I told them to forget about it entirely and come up with alternatives on how to incorporate their concerns into investigations by the Heavy Crime Investigation Office and the National Office of Investigation. The prosecution already has immense indictment power; if they also get supplementary investigation authority, they'll find ways to play games. <<> Of course, we also need to consider ways to prevent the National Office of Investigation and the Heavy Crime Investigation Office from playing games too. Initially, we can think about a strong authority to request supplementary investigations, and placing individuals with substantial responsibility and authority, such as from the Office for Government Policy Coordination, on each agency's investigation review committee. So they can say 'do it again' when investigations are shelved." <<> wonje@hani.co.kr ( “‘5공화국 전두환 국조’ ‘박근혜 국정농단 국조’ ‘윤석열 내란 국조’를 잇는 역사적인 현장에 있다는 생각을 했다. 천만 영화 ‘왕과 사는 남자’처럼 단종을 없애야 세조가 올라가는 그런 현장을 대한민국에서 보지 않았나. 이재명을 없애야 윤석열이 산다. 그래서 윤석열이 대통령이 되고 나서도 국가의 수사기관, 권력기관을 총동원해서 정적을 제거하려 했구나, 그게 다 드러난 현장이었다.” )

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: “An order to run? That’s presidential election interference.” Ha Jung-woo: “I persuaded the ‘Supreme Leader.’” (한동훈 “출마 지시? 대통령 선거개입”, 하정우 “내가 통님 설득”)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo, former senior presidential secretary for AI future strategy at the Blue House, and Han Dong-hoon, former leader of the People Power Party, are clashing on social media, as both are likely to face off in the by-election for the Buk-gu Gap constituency in Busan. (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 맞붙을 가능성이 큰 하정우 전 청와대 에이아이(인공지능·AI) 미래기획수석비서관과 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표가 사회관계망서비스(SNS)에서 맞붙고 있다.)

On Facebook on the 28th, former leader Han said, “Former senior secretary Ha said, ‘If President Lee Jae-myung tells me to run in Buk-gu Gap, I will run; otherwise, I’ll stay at the Blue House.’ Since he is running, it appears President Lee ultimately gave the order to run. I ask former secretary Ha and the Blue House: Did President Lee order him to run in Buk-gu Gap? If so, that is illegal election interference by the president.” (한 전 대표는 28일 페이스북에서 “하 전 수석은 ‘이재명 대통령이 부산 북갑에 출마하라고 해야 출마할 거고, 아니면 청와대에 남겠다’고 말했는데, 출마하는 것을 보니 이 대통령이 결국 출마 지시를 한 것으로 보인다”며 “하 전 수석과 청와대에 묻는다. 이 대통령이 하 전 수석에게 부산 북갑 출마 지시한 것 맞냐? 그렇다면, 이 대통령의 불법 선거개입이다”라고 말했다.)

After a netizen shared a news article about this on X (formerly Twitter) that same day, protesting to former secretary Ha, “Why are you dragging the president into this?”, Ha directly replied. (이 내용이 기사화된 것을 한 누리꾼이 이날 엑스(X)에 공유하며 하 전 수석을 향해 “왜 대통령님을 끌어들이냐?”고 항의하자, 하 전 수석은 직접 답글을 달았다.)

Former secretary Ha said, “I persuaded the ‘Supreme Leader’ (a nickname for Lee Jae-myung), and he readily agreed after hearing my opinion. He told me to work hard for the national interest wherever I go. It wasn’t an order from the Supreme Leader—I persuaded him, so it cannot be election interference. We don’t need to be swayed by such forced logic.” (하 전 수석은 “제가 통님을 설득했고 제 의견에 동의해서 바로 흔쾌히 수락했다. 그래서 어디서든 국익을 위해 힘쓰라 했다. 통님 지시가 아니고 제가 설득한 거니 선거 개입이 될 수 없다. 억지 논리에 일희일비할 필요 없다”고 말했다.)

In response, former leader Han shared Ha’s reply and said, “When I pointed out that if President Lee had ordered him to run, it would be illegal election interference, former secretary Ha changed his story, saying he himself persuaded the ‘Supreme Leader’ (President Lee Jae-myung, right?) to run, so it isn’t election interference. It’s a problem if former secretary Ha wanted to run but lied by using President Lee as an excuse, and it’s also a problem if President Lee did give an illegal order to run and they are lying as if it didn’t happen.” (이에 한 전 대표는 하 전 수석의 답글을 공유하며 “제가 이 대통령이 출마하라고 지시했다면 불법 선거개입이라고 지적하자, 하 전 수석 본인이 출마하겠다고 ‘통님(이재명 대통령 맞지요?)’을 설득했으니 선거개입이 아니라고 말을 바꿨다”라며 “하 전 수석 본인이 출마하고 싶은데도 이 대통령 핑계 대며 거짓말을 했어도 문제이고, 이 대통령이 불법 출마지시를 했음에도 아닌 것처럼 거짓말하는 것이어도 문제”라고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, former secretary Ha is set to begin his full-fledged campaign on the 29th, completing his party admission process at the Democratic Party headquarters in the morning and visiting Gupo Market in the Buk-gu Gap district in the afternoon. Accordingly, the Buk-gu Gap by-election, held alongside the June 3 local elections, is likely to be a three-way race between former secretary Ha of the Democratic Party, former leader Han, and a candidate from the People Power Party. Within the People Power Party, former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-shik and others are hoping to run. (한편, 하 전 수석은 29일 오전 더불어민주당 중앙당에서 입당 절차를 마친 뒤 오후 부산 북갑 지역구의 구포시장을 방문하는 등 본격적인 출마 행보에 나설 예정이다. 이에 따라 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 부산 북갑 보궐선거는 더불어민주당 하 전 수석과 한 전 대표, 그리고 국민의힘 후보가 겨루게 될 가능성이 커졌다. 국민의힘에선 박민식 전 국가보훈처 장관 등이 출마를 희망 중이다.)

Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Yong-nam "I'm in first place" – Cho Kuk "I will win"…'Pyeongtaek-eul Battle' heats up into a war of nerves (김용남 “내가 1등” 조국 “내가 이겨”…‘평택을 전투’ 기싸움 본격화)
item.description:
The campaign for the June 3 parliamentary by-election in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul is seeing a growing war of words between Kim Yong-nam, a former Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker, and Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party. (6·3 국회의원 경기 평택을 재선거에 출마한 김용남 전 더불어민주당 의원과 조국 조국혁신당 대표의 장외 기싸움이 이어지고 있다.)

On the 29th, candidate Kim shared on Facebook the results of a poll by 'Korea Research Flower,' which showed he had the highest approval rating among Pyeongtaek-eul candidates, saying, "The support the citizens of Pyeongtaek are showing me now is not so much an encouragement of me personally, but a fervent hope for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration, and a solemn yet heartfelt command to bring about the development of Pyeongtaek." He added, "I will not be intoxicated by the poll rankings. I will focus only on the essence of elections: the lives of the citizens." (김 후보는 29일 페이스북에 자신이 평택을 후보 중 지지율이 가장 높게 나타난 ‘여론조사 꽃’의 조사 결과를 공유하며 “지금 평택시민들이 보여주시는 지지는 저 개인에 대한 응원보다는, 이재명 정부의 성공을 향한 간절한 염원이자, 평택의 발전을 가져오라는 준엄하면서도 진심 어린 명령”이라고 말했다. 그는 “여론조사 순위에 도취하지 않겠다. 오직 선거의 본질인 ‘시민의 삶’에만 집중하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Candidate Cho appeared on the YouTube broadcast 'Kim Eo-jun's Humility is Hard News Factory' that day, which released this poll, and said, "People I meet in Pyeongtaek all say that until now, Pyeongtaek has never received national attention, so they're glad it's becoming a political hotspot, and that they hope someone who can resolve Pyeongtaek's long-standing issues will come." (조 후보는 이날 이 여론조사를 발표한 ‘김어준의 겸손은힘들다 뉴스공장’ 유튜브 방송에 출연해 “평택에서 만나는 분들이 지금까지 평택이 전국적 조명을 받은 적이 없는데 정치1번지가 되어서 좋다, 평택의 숙원사업을 해결해줄 사람이 오면 좋겠다는 이야기를 꼭 하신다”고 말했다.)

Regarding a potential unification with the Democratic Party, Candidate Cho stated, "Because I ran based on the premise of receiving the Democratic Party's nomination, I must naturally compete with and defeat the Democratic Party candidate," adding, "I have a duty to prove that Cho Kuk is better for the development of South Korea and Pyeongtaek than candidate Kim Yong-nam." He then said, "I am always open. It's too hasty to discuss it now; talks will likely happen around May 20th, when the election campaign officially begins." (조 후보는 민주당과의 단일화와 관련해 “민주당 공천을 전제로 출마했기 때문에 당연히 민주당 후보와 경쟁해서 이겨야 한다”며 “조국이 김용남 후보보다 대한민국과 평택 발전을 위해 더 낫다는 걸 입증할 의무를 갖는 것”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 “항상 열려 있다. 지금 이야기를 하는 건 성급하고, 5월20일 선거운동 개시일 그때쯤 얘기가 나올 것”이라고 했다.)

Responding aggressively to candidate Kim's past 'shots' regarding the controversy over private equity funds involving Cho himself and his family during his time as Minister of Justice, Candidate Cho said, "I want to be clear about this regarding my honor. The private equity fund issue was not even investigated, and while my fifth cousin and spouse were partially convicted, the judgment explicitly states there was no corrupt abuse of power related to me." He added, "If candidate Kim brings up these falsehoods again, I will counterattack to protect my own honor." He also directly demanded of candidate Kim, "Explain to the public three public statements you made: defending the 'Korea-Japan Comfort Women Agreement' during the Park Geun-hye administration, calling the activities of the Sewol Ferry Special Investigation Committee a 'waste of tax money,' and claiming the cause of the Itaewon disaster was the 'Gwanghwamun rally and Yongsan march the day before.'" item.title: Oh Se-hoon's First Pledge: 'Steel-Strength Seoul' – "Creating a 10-Minute Fitness Zone" (오세훈, 1호 공약 ‘강철 체력 서울’…“10분 운세권 만들 것”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, unveiled a 'Healthy City' as his first pledge on the 29th. The plan involves advancing Seoul's existing health management platform and expanding sports-for-life infrastructure, such as the Seoul Physical Fitness Test. (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 29일 1호 공약으로 ‘건강 도시’를 내걸었다. 기존 서울시 건강관리 플랫폼을 고도화하고 서울체력장 등 생활체육 인프라를 확충하겠다는 구상이다.)

On the morning of the same day, at the 'Seoul Fitness 9988 Dobong Center' located in the Dobong-gu Public Health Center, the candidate announced 'Steel-Strength, Vital Seoul' as his first pledge. Regarding the choice of health policies as his first pledge, he explained, "I constantly ask myself what citizens value most in their daily lives," and said, "It's not money, a house, or a job—it's health." He continued, "Our society has so far treated health solely as a personal matter," adding, "But health must be a public infrastructure that the city collaboratively designs and supports." The intent is to prevent disparities in income and assets from leading to health disparities. <<>> Oh announced that he would upgrade Seoul's health management platform 'Wrist Doctor 9988,' launched in 2021, into an AI-based health management super app. The advanced app plans to integrate personal health checkup results and exercise data to predict risks of chronic diseases such as diabetes and hypertension, as well as severe conditions like lung cancer. Oh stated, "By signing an MOU with the National Health Insurance Service, we will combine health-related disease histories with exercise data accumulated in the app," and "Based on exercise habits and disease/treatment histories, AI-customized prescriptions will become possible." Plans also include allowing the purchase of digital health devices, such as blood glucose monitors, using Wrist Doctor 9988 points, and providing sports facility vouchers to citizens diagnosed with obesity to encourage exercise. <<>> The sports-for-life infrastructure will also be significantly expanded. Oh announced the creation of a '10-minute fitness zone' city, where citizens can manage their physical fitness within 10 minutes of their home anywhere in Seoul. First, the number of 'Seoul Physical Fitness Centers' in residential areas, currently at 27, will be increased to 100. These centers are spaces where citizens can measure their fitness levels and receive exercise prescriptions. 'Fun Stations' centered on running and fitness, utilizing subway stations like Yeouinaru, Ttukseom, and Gwanghwamun, will also be expanded from the current 6 to 25. Additionally, 120 new 'Our Neighborhood Vitality Charging Stations' for the elderly will be established by 2030, and indoor and outdoor park golf courses and senior exercise playgrounds will be expanded. <<>> Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr ( 오 후보는 이날 오전 서울 도봉구보건소에 있는 ‘서울체력 9988 도봉센터’에서 ‘강철 체력, 활력 서울'을 첫 공약으로 발표했다. 그는 1호 공약으로 건강 정책을 선택한 이유에 대해 “시민들이 일상에서 가장 소중하게 여기는 것은 무엇일까를 늘 스스로 묻는다”며 “돈도, 집도, 직업도 아닌 건강”이라고 밝혔다. 이어 “우리 사회는 그동안 건강을 오롯이 개인의 문제로만 여겨왔다”며 “하지만 건강은 도시가 함께 설계하고 뒷받침해야 할 공공의 인프라여야 한다”고 했다. 소득·자산 격차가 건강 격차로 이어지는 것을 막겠다는 취지다.)

item.title: “Bae Hyun-jin, a cancerous presence”…Public remarks by People Power Party Supreme Council member appointed by Jang Dong-hyuk (“배현진, 암적 존재”…장동혁이 지명한 국힘 최고위원 공개발언)
item.description:
Cho Kwang-han, a Supreme Council member of the People Power Party appointed as a designated Supreme Council member by party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, criticized fellow party lawmaker Bae Hyun-jin, calling her "a cancerous presence in our party." <<> On the 28th, a broadcast on the channel of far-right YouTuber Koh Sung-kook showed Koh first launching into a critique of Rep. Bae during a conversation with Supreme Council member Cho. Koh said, "Looking at what Bae Hyun-jin is doing, it’s not just crossing the line—it’s deeply malicious and truly repetitive. She even belittled and harshly condemned Chairman Jang’s visit to the U.S., saying things like, ‘It seems he was deceived by some shady broker.’ Are you just going to let this slide?" <<> Earlier, Rep. Bae had consistently criticized Chairman Jang, making remarks such as, "You live such a difficult life, Jang Dong-hyuk" (March 12), "(Chairman Jang’s) campaign visits don’t help a single electoral district" (March 25), and "The worst anti-party act is all of Chairman Jang’s choices that hinder candidates and tank the party’s competitiveness" (April 23). On the 27th, on SBS Radio’s "Kim Tae-hyun’s Political Show," she said regarding Jang’s U.S. trip performance, "It seems like he was tricked by so-called brokers or lobbyists in the U.S., these shady people, and went there deceived." <<> In response to Koh’s remarks, Supreme Council member Cho said, "As Dr. Koh said, this (Rep. Bae’s criticism of Chairman Jang) is happening continuously and repeatedly. A lot of people are boiling with anger. If we were to mention that boiling anger, very unpleasant language would come out—because it becomes an attack on the other side." He added, "So, in fact, we have to see her as a cancerous presence in our party." <<> Supreme Council member Cho continued, "The Seoul party chapter has almost completely collapsed and been ruined," and "Many of our Seoul city party committee chairs have been hurt and are in a situation where they have no choice but to suppress their anger." This was another critique aimed at Rep. Bae, who serves as the chair of the People Power Party’s Seoul city chapter. He also appeared to target the court’s decision last month to grant Rep. Bae’s request for a temporary injunction, which halted the party’s ethics committee’s February punishment of a one-year suspension of her party membership, saying, "We also find it very troubling that the court has excessively intervened in the political activities of a political party." <<> Meanwhile, Rep. Bae was referred to the People Power Party’s ethics committee again on the 24th, following a previous referral in January. Some candidates for Seoul metropolitan and district council seats in the People Power Party cited the reason for the referral, stating, "The respondent (Rep. Bae), who is the Seoul city party committee chair, has not stopped criticizing and mocking the party leadership, including Chairman Jang, during this critical time ahead of the local elections." This referral came just one day after Chairman Jang returned from the U.S. and warned, "I will take strong action against anti-party behavior." <<> Regarding the ethics committee referral, Rep. Bae said on a radio show on the 27th, "It’s not something I need to worry about much," and "Since the court has already blocked them once before, the ethics committee won’t act rashly or recklessly." <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 지명직 최고위원으로 임명한 조광한 국민의힘 최고위원이 배현진 국민의힘 의원을 겨냥해 “우리 당의 암적 존재”라고 비판했다.)

item.title: Presidential Office Introduces ‘Grade 5 Promotion Fast Track’ for Civil Servants… Expands Open Positions (청와대, 공무원 ‘5급 승진 패스트트랙’ 도입…개방형 직위도 확대)
item.description:
On the 29th, the Presidential Office announced the ‘Public Service Competency Enhancement Plan,’ which includes the introduction of a ‘Grade 5 Promotion Fast Track’ for civil servants. (청와대가 29일 공무원 ‘5급 승진 패스트트랙’ 도입하는 내용 등을 담은 ‘공직 역량 강화 방안’을 발표했다.)

Chief of Staff to the President Kang Hoon-sik stated at a briefing at the Presidential Office, “By introducing the Grade 5 special promotion fast track, we will enable capable individuals to quickly grow into managerial roles,” adding, “This involves accelerated promotion after thorough verification, starting with 100 people this year and gradually expanding.” (강훈식 대통령비서실장은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “5급 특진 패스트트랙을 도입해 역량 있는 사람은 빠르게 관리자로 성장시키겠다”며 “철저한 검증을 거쳐 조기 승진시키는 것으로, 올해 100명을 시작으로 단계적으로 확대할 계획”이라고 말했다.)

Furthermore, the office announced plans to cultivate expert civil servants in fields such as artificial intelligence (AI), trade, and labor supervision. Chief Kang said, “In areas like AI, trade, and labor supervision, we will allow long-term service of over seven years to build expertise and provide regular training,” and “In particular, AI-related civil servants will work across ministry boundaries, such as the Ministry of Science and ICT and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety.” Currently, under the rotational assignment system, positions change every one to two years. Chief Kang added, “This is about creating a public service culture centered on performance and results.” (아울러 인공지능(AI) 통상, 노동감독 등 전문가 공무원을 양성하겠다고 밝혔다. 강 실장은 “에이아이, 통상, 노동감독 등의 분야는 7년 이상 장기 재직해서 실력을 쌓을 수 있게 하고 주기적으로 교육하겠다”며 “특히 인공지능 관련 공무원은 과학기술정보통신부, 행정안전부 등 부처 칸막이 없이 일하도록 하겠다”고 말했다. 현재는 순환보직 제도에 따라 1~2년이 지나면 보직을 바꾸게 된다. 강 실장은 “실적과 성과 중심의 공직문화를 만들겠다는 것”이라고 했다.)

As a measure to attract private-sector talent, the office also decided to gradually expand ‘open positions.’ As of January last year, open positions at the bureau and division head level accounted for 7.1%, with a plan to increase this to 12% by 2030. According to the plan, salary caps will be abolished for certain positions, and employment restrictions will be eased. Additionally, the office announced plans to systematize lifelong education for civil servants and establish a national-level overseas human network management system. (민간 인재를 유인하는 방안으로 ‘개방형 직위’도 단계적으로 확대해 나가기로 했다. 지난해 1월 기준 국·과장급 개방형 직위는 7.1%인데, 오는 2030년까지 12%로 늘리겠다는 것이다. 직위에 따라 연봉 상한을 폐지하고 취업제한을 완화한다는 계획이다. 이 밖에도 공무원 생애주기별 교육을 체계화하고 국가 차원의 해외 인적네트워크 관리체계도 구축하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Chief Kang stated, “We will immediately amend relevant laws to implement this swiftly,” adding, “I believe this will serve as a foundation for a dramatic leap in public service competency amid a rapidly changing environment.” (강 실장은 “즉시 관계 법령을 개정해 신속하게 시행하겠다”며 “급변하는 환경 속에서 공직 역량을 획기적으로 도약시키는 밑바탕이 되리라고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.description:
Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, and Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, each announced their pledges for the June 3 local elections, kicking off their policy campaigns in earnest. Democratic candidate Jung Won-oh visited the Jangwi redevelopment district in Seongbuk-dong, Seoul on the 29th and unveiled a real estate policy focused on shortening redevelopment project timelines and supplying a large volume of 'substantial housing.' Candidate Jung stated, "We will supply a large number of public housing units at prices and rents that are affordable for non-homeowning middle-class citizens." (정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 각각 6·3 지방선거 공약을 발표하며 본격적인 정책 행보를 시작했다. 정원오 민주당 후보는 29일 서울 성북동 장위재개발지구를 현장방문해 정비사업 기간의 단축과 ‘실속주택’ 대규모 공급을 주요 내용으로 하는 부동산 정책을 발표했다. 정 후보는 “무주택 중산층 서민들도 부담 가능한 분양가와 임대료의 공공주택을 대규모로 공급하겠다”고 말했다.)

People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon announced 'Steel Stamina, Vibrant Seoul' as his first pledge. On the 29th, at the Dobong-gu Public Health Center in Seoul, Oh unveiled a public health pledge, declaring the creation of an urban environment where everyone can enjoy a healthy daily life regardless of where they live or their income level, as the top priority for completing quality of life. Candidate Oh emphasized, "Regardless of where you live or what you do, health should not be a goal but part of daily life itself in Seoul," adding, "Reducing health disparities by region and income is a key task for completing the 'Special City of Quality of Life' and enhancing urban competitiveness." Afterward, Oh visited Ssangmun Market in Dobong-gu, Seoul, and the area known as Ssangridangil to meet with citizens. (오세훈 국민의힘 후보는 1호 공약으로 ‘강철 체력, 활력 서울’을 발표했다. 오 후보는 29일 서울 도봉구보건소에서 삶의 질을 완성하기 위한 최우선 과제로 거주 지역이나 소득 수준과 관계없이 누구나 건강한 일상을 누리는 도시 환경을 조성하겠다고 시민 건강공약을 밝혔다. 오 후보는 “어디에 살든, 어떤 일을 하든 건강은 목표가 아니라 서울에서의 일상 그 자체여야 한다”라며 “지역·소득별 건강 격차를 줄이는 것이야말로 ‘삶의 질 특별시’를 완성하고 도시 경쟁력을 높이는 핵심 과제”라고 강조했다. 이후 오 후보는 서울 도봉구 쌍문시장과 일명 쌍리단길을 찾아 시민들을 만났다.)

item.title: President Lee Orders Review to Allow Use of High Oil Price Subsidies at Gas Stations with Annual Revenue Over 3 Billion Won (이 대통령 “매출 30억 이상 주유소서 고유가 지원금 가능하게” 검토 지시)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung reportedly instructed on the 29th that the high oil price relief subsidies be made available for use at gas stations with annual revenue of 3 billion won or more. (이재명 대통령이 고유가 피해지원금을 ‘연 매출 30억원 이상 주유소’에서도 사용할 수 있도록 검토해보라고 지시한 것으로 29일 알려졌다.)

Chief Presidential Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Lee Gyu-yeon said on KBS Radio that day, "(Yesterday) President Lee asked senior secretaries for their opinions on the restriction of using high oil price relief subsidies at gas stations with annual revenue over 3 billion won. He said, 'Intuitively, citizens see it as a high oil price relief subsidy, so shouldn't they be allowed to at least fill up on gas?' and ordered a review in the direction of easing that restriction." (이규연 청와대 홍보소통수석은 이날 한국방송(KBS) 라디오에서 “전날 (이 대통령이) 수석들에게(연 매출 30억 이상 주유소에서 고유가 피해지원금 사용 제한에 대한) 의견을 들어보자고 했다”며 “‘아무래도 국민들이 직관적으로 받아들이는 것은 고유가 피해 지원금이니까 기름 정도는 넣을 수 있게 해야 되는 거 아니냐’ 해서 그걸 한 번 풀어주는 방향으로 검토해 보라고 (이 대통령이) 지시를 내렸다”고 말했다.)

The government has been providing 'high oil price relief subsidies' since the 27th to alleviate the increased burden on citizens due to the prolonged US-Israel/Iran war. However, it was pointed out that the inability to use these subsidies at gas stations with annual revenue of 3 billion won or more has caused inconvenience. (정부는 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 장기화 탓에 늘어난 국민들의 부담 완화를 위해 오는 27일부터 ‘고유가 피해지원금’을 지급하고 있다. 그런데 연매출 30억원 이상인 주유소에서는 이를 쓸 수 없어 불편하다는 지적이 제기된 바 있다.)
